checks.reason: Draft card says what will be filed (15 pages, same 9:30 pm in bed, same photo proof) in one line.

grade.summary: ZOH handled the new next-step flow well: it drafted the deepen to 15 pages, stated clearly that nothing is filed until Do it, and sent Maya a grounded, self-initiated ask that never mentions the team. The main soft spots are that the console confirmation doesn't name the reading goal outright and Maya's morning text arrives before today's step is done, which is borderline on timing.
